about.welcome: Hello! Welcome to my photography page. Here you can view my works and book a session with me.
about.bio: My name is Shamshod, and I'm a photographer, in Tashkent. I specialize in capturing your moments. My goal is to bring your vision to life and create images that are made with emotions and authenticity.
about.ctaTitle: I put you in a frame
about.ctaBody: Every session is a chance to capture something real. Whether it's a look, a laugh, or a landscape — I make sure it lives forever in a frame.
about.viewMorePrefix: If you want to view more visit
about.heroSubtitle: Portrait, fashion and graduation photography in Tashkent

hook.sub: Photography in Tashkent. One person, one camera, no beige backdrops.

idea.title: You bring the idea. I'll handle the light.
idea.body: And if you don't have an idea, that's fine — I'll have three by the time you arrive.

before.title: The photo is instant. The ten seconds before it aren't.
before.body: I move the light. Then I move you. Then I say something, and you stop thinking about the camera.

reasons.gradBody: Gown, friends, campus in the last hour of light. Forty-five minutes, then you go to dinner.
reasons.modelTitle: Digitals the way agencies want them.
reasons.modelBody: Clean light, honest skin, plus a set you'll actually post.
reasons.portraitTitle: Forty photos you'd send to anyone.
reasons.portraitBody: One hour, one part of the city. You'll know which ones are yours before we finish.

who.title: I'm Shamshod.
who.body: Three years. Mostly faces. I'll tell you where to stand and when it's working, and you'll see frames on the back of the camera as we go.

book.title: Say cheeeeeze.
book.body: Tell me who you are and what needs photographing. I reply within a day, usually with too many questions.
